newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian retail sales up 16.8 pct in March mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: Croatian retail sales up 16.8 pct in March mth/mth.

text.p: Croatia's retail sales rose 16.8 percent in March after shrinking 0.2 percent in February, the State Bureau of Statistics reported on Thursday.
This lifted the first quarter sales a total of 32.3 percent compared to the same period of 1996, it said. The March increase was put at 34.5 percent on an annual level.
The monthly rise overshot expectations of some 500 leading retailers by over 50 percent.
Their stocks ended 4.1 percent higher than in February after leftovers from the Easter shopping boom.
Retailers accounting for more than half of the total sector forecast the sales to increase one percent in April and reduce stocks by a meagre 0.1 percent.
Turnover is calculated in current prices. They rose 0.2 percent in March on a monthly basis and were running at 2.9 percent annually. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
